abstract: Purpose: To investigate the predictive performance of multi-sequence MRI habitat radiomics for early recurrence (ER) following curative resection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and to provide preoperative imaging evidence to guide personalized diagnosis and treatment. Methods: This study collected retrospective clinical data from a total of 260 PDAC patients at two medical centers. Tumors were segmented into three habitat subregions via unsupervised K-means clustering. Radiomic features from these subregions were used to construct the habitat models. The performance of the traditional clinical model, the whole-tumor radiomics model, the single-sequence habitat models, the combined habitat model, and the Clinic-Habitat combined model was compared. The model's validity was evaluated using a series of metrics, including the area under the ROC curve (AUC), calibration curve analysis, and decision curve analysis (DCA). The results of the model were interpreted using the additive interpretation method of SHAP. Spearman's rank-order correlation analysis was performed to explore biological correlations between radiomic scores and pathological markers. Risk-stratified survival analysis was implemented based on model-derived optimal cutoff values. Results: The Clinic-Habitat model demonstrated the best performance, with AUCs of 0.922 (training), 0.896 (internal validation), and 0.886 (external test), outperforming the clinical baseline model, the clinical-pathological model, the individual-sequence habitat models, and the whole-tumor radiomics model. SHAP analysis indicated that T1WI-Hab-score1 exerted the greatest influence on model predictions. The Hab-radiomic score was significantly correlated with pathological markers reflecting tumor aggressiveness. A cutoff value of 0.556 derived from the Clinic-Habitat model effectively stratified patients into high- and low-risk ER subgroups, with Kaplan-Meier curves showing a significant difference in RFS between the two groups (p < 0.001). Conclusions: Multi-sequence MRI-based habitat radiomics enables preoperative prediction of ER risk in PDAC and facilitates patient risk stratification and personalized treatment planning.
key_points_ko: 총 260명의 췌장암 환자 데이터를 분석한 결과, 임상-서식지 결합 모델은 외부 검증 집단에서 수신자 조작 특성 곡선 아래 면적(AUC) 0.886의 높은 예측 정확도를 나타냈습니다.
T1 강조 영상 기반 서식지 점수(T1WI-Hab-score1)가 조기 재발 예측에 가장 큰 영향을 미치는 영상 특성으로 확인되었습니다.
모델에서 도출된 절단값(0.556)을 기준으로 환자를 위험도별로 분류했을 때 두 군 간 무재발 생존기간(RFS)에 통계적으로 유의미한 차이가 있었습니다(p < 0.001).
summary_ko: 췌관선암(PDAC)의 근치적 절제술 후 조기 재발 위험을 수술 전에 예측하기 위해 환자 260명의 다중 수퀀스 자기공명영상(MRI) 데이터를 분석했습니다. 연구진은 종양 내부를 3개의 서식지 하위 영역으로 분할하고, 임상 정보와 라디오믹스(radiomics) 특징을 결합한 임상-서식지 모델을 구축했습니다. 분석 결과, 임상-서식지 모델은 기존 임상 모델이나 전체 종양 기반 모델보다 우수한 재발 예측 성능을 나타냈습니다. 또한 이 모델을 통해 수술 후 조기 재발 위험이 높은 환자군과 낮은 환자군을 효과적으로 구분할 수 있었습니다.
title: MRI-Based Habitat Radiomics for Predicting Early Recurrence After Pancreatic Cancer Resection
title_ko: MRI 기반 서식지 라디오믹스를 활용한 췌장암 수술 후 조기 재발 예측
